messages:
maya: Quick sync — we're consolidating final GA acceptance for the launch bucket. Need explicit owners for SLA, docs, support runbook, monitoring alerts, and pricing comms. Customers with high priority asks: Stripe-Embed, Kiva Labs.

sam: Can we confirm SLA targets? Current proposal: 99.9% availability and p50 latency < 150ms for hosted API, p95 < 350ms. Is that still acceptable for commercial? @devon

devon: 99.9 is fine for pilot deals, but enterprise pilot customers want an SLO page with failure modes. Also need an escalation contact and RTO for Dedicated. I'll draft comms.

maya: Good. Owner breakdown: SLA & runbook — sam; Docs & quickstarts — rachel; Monitoring & alerts — li; Pricing comms + customer asks — devon. Can everyone ack?

rachel: Ack. I'll prioritize a condensed quickstart for private + dedicated flows and a "What to expect" table for latency/cost.

li: Ack. I will add alert thresholds and a runbook skeleton. Question: do we keep automatic fallback to lower-capacity model variants on overload? That affects docs and SLA wording.

sam: Yes, fallback is in plan. We'll document graceful degradation and circuit-breaker behavior. For SLA we call out "best-effort graceful degradation" and list what is covered vs. not.

maya: Timeline: Baked-in wording and runbook draft by Thu COB (1781235200). Docs draft by Fri COB. Can we make the SLA language explicit enough for sales to include in pilot contracts?

devon: I'll take the draft and create a one-pager for customers. Also need a table mapping plan -> guaranteed throughput and burst allowances.

rachel: One more: Support coverage — define oncall tier for first 90 days. Recommend 24/7 page for Dedicated enterprise customers. @li any concerns?

li: We can do 24/7 with current staffing if critical alerts are routed correctly. Need runbook playbooks for common incidents: high-latency, OOMs, KV-cache corruption.

maya: OK. Action items summarized:
- sam: SLA language + runbook skeleton (due 1781235200)
- rachel: Docs quickstart + customer expectations (due 1781235600)
- li: Monitoring thresholds + incident playbooks (due 1781235800)
- devon: Pricing table + customer one-pager (due 1781236000)

Please update the thread when you push PRs. If anyone needs scope trimmed for GA, call it out now. :eyes:

sam: small request — can we defer advanced autoscaling knob (per-tenant burst pools) to post-GA? It would reduce scope and docs churn.

maya: Agreed — defer advanced per-tenant burst pools to v1.1. Noted.

devon: Sounds good. I'll note that in comms. Thanks all.

ops-bot: Reminder: next release cut is scheduled at 1781236800 — freeze window starts 1 hour prior.

maya: Thanks — closing this sync. Ping in thread if blockers appear.
